definitions.explanation: merchandise being received and stocked at a store or warehouse

examples.japanese: {新商品|しんしょうひん}が{入荷|にゅうか}した。
{次|つぎ}の{入荷|にゅうか}は{来週|らいしゅう}の{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: The next shipment is scheduled for next week.

examples.japanese: {入荷|にゅうか}したら{連絡|れんらく}します。
examples.english: I'll contact you when it comes in.

notes:
{入荷|にゅうか} is a retail/business term for goods arriving at a store or warehouse.

WORD TYPE:
- Noun
- Also used as する verb: {入荷|にゅうか}する (to arrive, to come in stock)

KANJI BREAKDOWN:
- {入|にゅう} (enter)
- {荷|か} (cargo, goods)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {入荷|にゅうか}する (to arrive in stock)
- {新{入荷|にゅうか}} (newly arrived stock)
- {入荷|にゅうか}{予定|よてい} (expected arrival)
- {入荷|にゅうか}{待|ま}ち (waiting for restocking)
- {入荷|にゅうか}{次第|しだい} (as soon as it arrives)

ANTONYM:
- {出荷|しゅっか} (shipment out)

RELATED TERMS:
- {欠品|けっぴん} (out of stock)
- {在庫|ざいこ} (inventory)
- {再入荷|さいにゅうか} (restocking)
- {取|と}り{寄|よ}せ (special order)

USAGE CONTEXT:
- Retail stores
- Online shopping
- Customer service
- Inventory management

COMMON SITUATIONS:
- "When will it be back in stock?" → {入荷|にゅうか}{予定|よてい}を{確認|かくにん}する
- "Just arrived!" → {本日|ほんじつ}{入荷|にゅうか}!
- "Waiting for stock" → {入荷|にゅうか}{待|ま}ち

REGISTER: Business/retail vocabulary. Common in customer service.
